§ Origin rules: allowed origins are exactly profile.siteUrl's origin (https://michael-herron.vercel.app), any https host matching the Vercel preview pattern written as a regex in the plan and derived from the real preview host `portfolio-site-git-harness-merg-e67481-mh550s-projects-e64e7e0b.vercel.app` (PR #16's Vercel comment; pattern `^portfolio-site-[a-z0-9-]+-mh550s-projects(-[a-z0-9]+)?\.vercel\.app$`), and in development only (process.env.NODE_ENV !== 'production') http://localhost:<any port> and http://127.0.0.1:<any port>; a request with no Origin header is forbidden; the comparison is on the whole origin string parsed with `new URL`, never a substring test.

§ Address hash: the address is the first comma-separated entry of x-forwarded-for, trimmed, or the literal 'unknown' when the header is absent (so every local tab shares one bucket); addr10 = the first 10 hex characters of HMAC-SHA256(key = LIVEKIT_API_SECRET, message = address); the address and addr10 never appear in any response body, header or console line; the room name is concierge-<addr10>-<randomBytes(6) hex>; a room is 'this address's' when its name starts with `concierge-<addr10>-`.

Try again in a few minutes.'; any other non-OK stays offline.
